item.title: Berlin bedtime
item.description: This article describes a person's experience discovering Berlin's underground techno scene, starting from a spontaneous summer evening that led them to an unexpected party in an old factory building. They were captivated by the unique atmosphere, the community, and the DIY aspect of the event. The author expresses pride in being part of this movement and grateful for the organizers who pour their love into creating these experiences.

item.title: editorial
item.description: This is the first issue of proud magazine, which aims to provide a guide for living in Berlin. The editorial team defines itself with an ironic twist on professions ending in "-ist" and invites readers to join them on a journey of glamour, style, sex, and yoga, with the ultimate goal of taking over the city. It ends with the slogans "Be Berlin. Be proud." and a date and location from Hong Kong.

item.title: fritz helder
item.description: This article introduces Fritz Helder & The Phantoms, highlighting their exciting live performances and catchy music. It also reviews TRAKTOR SCRATCH PRO, discussing its features like vinyl emulation, effects, loop function, and cover display, concluding that it offers great possibilities for DJs despite the importance of human interaction in music discovery.
